cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, shutil, sqlite3, json

# 1) preserve original encrypted WAL truth
shutil.copy('/app/main.db-wal', '/app/main.db-wal.original.enc')
shutil.copy('/app/main.db-wal', '/tmp/original_main.db-wal.enc')

# 2) decrypt WAL in place (XOR 0x42)
enc = open('/app/main.db-wal.original.enc','rb').read()
dec = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in enc)
open('/tmp/dec_main.db-wal','wb').write(dec)
open('/app/main.db-wal','wb').write(dec)
print('wal decrypted, size', len(dec))

# 3) verify on a scratch copy
work='/tmp/scratch1'
shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(work)
shutil.copy('/app/main.db', work+'/main.db')
shutil.copy('/tmp/dec_main.db-wal', work+'/main.db-wal')
con = sqlite3.connect(work+'/main.db')
rows = con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
print('scratch rows:', len(rows))
print(rows)
con.close()

out = [{'id': int(r[0]), 'name': str(r[1]), 'value': int(r[2])} for r in rows]
with open('/app/recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f)
print('written recovered.json:', len(out), 'records')
EOF
echo "---"; cat /app/recovered.json; echo; ls -la /app
